links.comparator_used: Vendor-recommended adult thresholds applied to children
links.outcome: Diagnostic performance (sensitivity and specificity) of the AI tool for relevant chest radiograph findings in children
links.effect: With the adult threshold, older children (7-14 years) had AUC 0.96 (95% CI 0.94-0.98), sensitivity 87.5% and specificity 82.3%; performance 'further increased' with optimized pediatric thresholds (no numbers given in the abstract)
links.quote: In stratified analysis by age (2-7 vs. 7-14-years-old) a significantly higher performance (p < 0.001) was found for older children with an AUC of 0.96 (95% CI: 0.94-0.98) with a sensitivity and specificity of 87.5% and 82.3% respectively, which further increased using optimized thresholds for children.

design_hint: local threshold optimization for pediatric population
